errors.evidence: The red line shows a steep increase from 1248 at B2 to 1563 at C2. Describing this as a 'relatively stable trend' is highly inaccurate.
The legend label for the blue line is '未去除偏误', not '未去偏偏误'. The description has an extra character.
The blue line increases from 1193 at A1 to 1244 at A2; it does not decrease.
This description misses the dip in the blue line's value from 1244 at A2 down to 1225 at B1 before rising again.
The peak value for the blue line is 1563, which occurs at C2. The value at C1 is 1342, but it is not the peak.
